Class CollisionInformation

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Contains the information of a collision between two collision objects in the form of a list of collisions. Each collision is an intersection or overlap between two colliders.

public class CollisionInformation : List<Collision>, IList<Collision>, ICollection<Collision>, IReadOnlyList<Collision>, IReadOnlyCollection<Collision>, IEnumerable<Collision>, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable

Remarks

Provides methods for validation, filtering, and aggregation of collision points across multiple collisions.
